prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a parking lot collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1060; do not mention it.)
text:
This letter confirms that our firm now represents the injured party in connection with the parking lot collision described in the claim file. Please direct all further communications regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, email, or in person. If your insured or any representative has already been in contact with our client, please note that we are now handling all discussions on her behalf.

We request that you disclose the full liability policy limits applicable to your insured, including any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply, and provide a copy of the declarations page for each policy. Please also confirm the identity of the adjuster assigned to this file.

We further ask that your company preserve all evidence related to the incident. This includes photographs, surveillance or security camera footage, vehicle data and telematics, repair estimates, recorded statements, claim notes, and any communications with the insured or third parties. Please suspend any routine deletion or overwriting of such materials until this matter is fully resolved. Our client's injuries and damages are ongoing, and we will provide a detailed demand once her medical treatment has progressed further.
